An '''attack''' was launched by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against a [[Separatist munitions factory]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] succeeded in infiltrating the factory and sabotaging its powerful [[Force field/Legends|force field]], paving the way for a trio of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Trask (captain)|Trask]] to open fire on the facility. However, the assault was halted by the arrival of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]'', which destroyed the three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] before they could attack. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jyl Somtay]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] a [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]], picked up Skywalker and Kenobi and escaped as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kirst (admiral)|Kirst]] ordered a tractor beam, however, the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] managed to enter hyperspace leaving the weapons factory undamaged.
